fact: The Lesotho Bureau of Statistics lists the National Strategy for the Development of Statistics (NSDS) 2022/23-2026/27 among its current strategic documents; the page carries no date, so the published date 2026-08-29 is used.

The STATAFRIC peer review (mission 25-29 August 2025) describes NSDS II, covering 2022/23-2026/27, as Lesotho's most recent statistical strategy, with five strategic goals and over 80% of its budget allocated to the Bureau.
PARIS21's January 2026 NSDS status table lists the strategy as implementing (adopted): NSDS 2022-2027.
